answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade. The stake grows like a pearl formed layer by layer: each honest transaction adds reputation, while a detected duplicate identity forfeits the whole deposit at once. Past work records act as a relic of behavior, so a fresh account cannot borrow trust it never earned. A signed attestation, the quill certifying each trade, ties every action to one staked key, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, and the attacker pays more than any fraud could earn.
